rules.rationale: Reverses the uncertain source ring prior: rigid polycyclic solutes pack apolar surface and solvate poorly in water.
Acyclic and heteroatom-free together mark pure hydrocarbons, whose hydration is entropically costly despite the acyclic bonus.
Highly branched skeletons raise hydrophobic surface area and reduce favorable water contact per heavy atom.
Unsaturated centers often accompany carbonyl and imine groups, which are strong hydration acceptors.

skill.hypothesis: Tests whether ring topology and unsaturation proxy hydrogen-bonding capacity, downweighting the high-transfer-weight source ring relation. It fails if ring presence genuinely tracks favorable hydration in the top pool.
